# MS20 — MS-20 style synth for Korg drumlogue

Generated by korgTools. This folder is a drumlogue synth unit for the Korg logue SDK.

## Build it (Windows, one-time setup)
1. Install WSL2 (open PowerShell as admin: `wsl --install`) and Docker Desktop, then restart.
2. Open the Ubuntu app and run:
       git clone https://github.com/korginc/logue-sdk.git
       cd logue-sdk
       git config core.autocrlf input
       git submodule update --init
       cd docker && ./build_image.sh && cd ..
3. Copy Korg's template:  cp -r platform/drumlogue/dummy-synth platform/drumlogue/ms20
4. Copy the 4 files from this zip (header.c, unit.cc, synth.h, config.mk) into
   platform/drumlogue/ms20, replacing the ones there.
5. Build:  ./docker/run_cmd.sh build drumlogue/ms20
   You get platform/drumlogue/ms20/ms20.drmlgunit

## Put it on the drumlogue
1. Start the drumlogue in USB mass storage mode (see the "USB" section of its manual) and connect it — it shows up as a drive.
2. Copy the .drmlgunit file into Units/Synths/.
3. Eject the drive and power-cycle. Choose the synth on the drumlogue's synth part.
